AWS Bedrock returns 403 Forbidden (not 401) when credentials are missing, expired, or the IAM role lacks bedrock:InvokeModel permission — verifies the error is mapped to Authentication

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:liter_llm/liter_llm.dart';
import 'package:liter_llm/src/liter_llm_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    try {
      final req = await createChatCompletionRequestFromJson(json: '{"messages":[{"content":"Hello","role":"user"}],"model":"bedrock/anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0"}');
      final apiKey = Platform.environment['API_KEY'];
        if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty) { throw StateError('API_KEY must be set'); }
        final client = await LiterLlmBridge.createClient(apiKey);
      final result = await client.chat(req: req);
      stdout.writeln(result);
    } catch (error) {
      stderr.writeln('${error.runtimeType}: $error');
    }
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
